changelog.title: What's New
items: ✨ feat(playback): expose the active queue, pause-at-end and queue snapshots for Music Flow
✨ feat(musicflow): add the queue that feeds the playback service from the Music Flow session
✨ feat(musicflow): add Music Flow preferences and the candidate repository
✨ feat(musicflow): add the Music Flow core models, ranking, coordinator and session
✨ feat(playback): add export task queue with duplicate suppression
✨ feat(utils): add hero carousel, quick pick and playlist navigation helpers

changelog.title: Fixes
items: 🔧 fix(auto): keep covers in memory so the first metadata update already carries them
🔧 fix(player): keep playing after the app is closed by default
🔧 fix: compile error in the database wrapper, clean artist names, car-connect autoplay, addon track ids; version 1.4.4
🔧 fix(build): resolve compile errors in the home view model, database wrapper, music service and Music Flow repository
🔧 fix(musicflow): restore the trailing comma in the repository's filter arguments
🔧 fix: stop the background service after task clear, stable download order, and block unsafe AI endpoints
🔧 fix(home): apply blocked artist and explicit filters to quick picks; safe playlist routes
🔧 fix(res): add missing launcher icons and drawable images
🔧 fix(res): add missing TV banner and rename quick settings icon
🔧 feat(player,ui): playback recovery fix, varispeed, addon toggle, subscribe pill, carousel, share
